topic: Building a Finance Strategy, Not Just a Loan
objective: Encourage a strategic, ongoing view of business finance rather than one-off borrowing.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A finance strategy looks at how different facilities, a line of credit for flexibility, equipment finance for assets, working capital for timing gaps, work together over time, rather than treating each borrowing decision in isolation. It's a more deliberate way to support ongoing growth.

caption:
Most businesses end up with finance decisions made one at a time, each in response to whatever pressure or opportunity is immediate. A more deliberate approach looks at the whole picture, which facility suits which kind of need, and how they work together as the business changes.

That shift, from reactive borrowing to an ongoing strategy, tends to serve growing businesses better over time.
